title: Hand of the Isle deployment diagram
description: How Hand of the Isle runs: one Cloudflare Worker with static assets and no storage, on the route icelander.net/games/fresh/hand-of-the-isle*, for signed-in players holding games:hand-of-the-isle. The browser runs the Godot WebAssembly export. The engine's .wasm is larger than Cloudflare's 25 MiB limit for a static file, so build.mjs stores it in 20 MiB parts and the Worker streams the parts back as one file.
